cases.description: Default --still still picture. No M3 tool.
cases.note: Control: every per-tool stream below must differ from this one.

cases.description: CDEF only. One strength set is the smallest cdef_params() form (no cdef_idx symbols). The strength search prunes to one set at 64x64, so strengths 1..8 produce identical bytes.
cases.note: Sequence enable_cdef=1, frame cdef_params(), read_cdef() at the coding block, post-deblock filter. Tile bytes do not grow because only the frame header grows.

cases.description: Band-offset CCSO only. max_band_log2=2 is the smallest setting that changes reconstruction on this fixture; 0 and 1 are syntactically valid but select zero offsets and decode identically to baseline.
cases.note: Sequence enable_ccso=1 + ccso_unit_matches_sb_size=1, frame ccso_params() for all three planes, read_ccso() per 64x64 unit. Smallest ACTIVE configuration.

cases.description: Full-trellis coefficient RDOQ only. No syntax change; only quantized levels and therefore the coded coefficients differ.
cases.note: Default lambda sse_scale 0.125. The trellis levels feed the same syntax writer and inverse transform.

cases.description: Intra luma TX_TYPE search only. Chroma stays DCT_DCT via enable_chroma_dctonly=1; identity types stay excluded because enable_idtx_intra=0.
cases.note: Default lambda sse_scale 0.125. Blocks that fall to eob<=1 are re-quantized as DCT_DCT because the decoder infers DCT there.

missing_syntax: §5.20.10.4 read_lr() / §5.20.10.6 read_wienerns_filter() (no tile call before read_partition())
blocked.reason: The pixel core (§7.20.3 non-separable Wiener, 32/12-tap plus chroma-from-luma) exists, and filters_stream::lr_write_params()/lr_write_block() implement the syntax, but neither is wired into the M1 sequence/frame/tile writers. There is no encoder decision path for a single-class frame filter and no call site, so no valid IVF can be emitted without editing encoder code.

evidence.note: Sequence restoration flag is hardcoded off.

evidence.pattern: loop restoration \(Wiener\) tile syntax is not
evidence.note: The only tiled writer rejects enable_restoration outright.
No §5.20.10.4 read_lr() call site in the M1 tile writer.
Frame-filter syntax helper is not called by the integrated encoder.
No CLI switch can request Wiener NS.

blocked.reason: The M1 frame header hardcodes delta_q_present=0 and the tile writer never codes read_delta_qindex(). A per-superblock qindex changes dequantization and reconstruction, so a stream cannot be faked by reusing the baseline coefficient path.

evidence.note: No CLI switch can request delta-Q.

missing_syntax: §5.18.6.2 setup_qm_params() using_qmatrix / pic_qm_num_minus_1 / qm_y / qm_u / qm_v
§6.17.6.2 QM level selection and the dequantization-matrix path
blocked.reason: The M1 frame header hardcodes using_qmatrix=0. There is no QM level table, no per-segment QM level selection, and the coefficient dequantizer does not apply a matrix. Merely flipping the header bit would desynchronise or decode wrong pixels.

evidence.note: No CLI switch can request QM.

blocked.reason: The M1 frame header hardcodes segmentation_enabled=0 and the tile writer has no segment-id symbol or segment feature state. Segmentation changes qindex/filter features per block, so it needs its own decision and syntax path.

evidence.note: No segment-id symbol in the M1 tile writer.
No CLI switch can request segmentation.
